spec_basis: STU-ASSET-004: Studio MUST NOT implement ... a second metadata, keyword, rating, label or flag store; a second collection or smart-collection mechanism over assets
STU-ASSET-010: Studio MUST reach CKC through typed commands (asset.search, asset.get, ...), never through direct filesystem access or a private index
STU-ASSET-017: the projection reads and writes CKC authority records through the commands of STU-ASSET-010 ... and holds no catalog state of its own

STU-ASSET-019: Studio's asset projection inherits, and MUST NOT re-implement ... hierarchical keyword tagging, 0-to-5 star rating, colour labels, pick/reject/unflagged flags, manual collections, rule-based smart collections ... EXIF/IPTC/XMP metadata read and write ... virtual copies. Where a Studio workflow needs one of these, it calls it
STU-ASSET-022: a model lane has exactly the same asset access ... the same KernelActor attribution
STU-ASSET-023: Mutating the CKC asset record itself (retag, rate, move, delete) uses the expected-revision precondition of STU-SDB-004 at asset granularity
STU-RAW-017: Multi-image apply ... MUST operate on the canonical selection set, not on the visible or loaded subset (applied to library edit selections too)
notes.spec_tension: STU-ASSET-004 forbids a second smart-collection mechanism; the dispatch asks for rule evaluation in Studio over port-provided records. Resolution taken: ckc_rules is a stateless preview/validation helper (no membership store, no index, nothing persisted; CKC executes asset.search and owns smart collections). The lead may narrow it to check_acyclic only if it is judged a mechanism.
notes.ownership: no catalog store: all reads/writes go through CkcCatalogPort; the double stays feature/test-only; no new dependency or edge
